title: Arecanut — Pest Management: Red Palm Weevil, Spindle Bug, Root Grub
content:
MAJOR PESTS OF ARECANUT:

1. RED PALM WEEVIL (Rhynchophorus ferrugineus):
Most destructive pest. Grubs bore into trunk.
Symptoms: Oozing fermented sap, wilting of crown, holes in trunk, presence of grubs.
Management:
- Pheromone traps: Ferrolure+ @ 4 traps/ha — mass trapping of adults.
- Trunk injection: Monocrotophos 36 SL 10 ml + 10 ml water per palm (severe cases).
- Chlorpyriphos 20 EC 5 ml/L pouring into trunk holes.
- Physical: Apply tar/bitumen on cut wounds immediately.
- Emamectin benzoate trunk injection for heavy infestation (by expert).

2. SPINDLE BUG (Carvalhoia arecae):
Symptoms: Yellowing and drying of spindle leaf, leaf base brown, nut setting affected.
Management: Imidacloprid 70 WG @ 0.3g/L + Neem oil 3% spray in spindle.

3. INFLORESCENCE CATERPILLAR (Tirathaba mundella):
Symptoms: Webbing and feeding on flower bunches, premature nut fall.
Management: Chlorpyriphos 20 EC @ 2.5 ml/L spray on inflorescence.
Biological: Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) @ 2g/L.

4. ROOT GRUB (Leucopholis coneophora):
Symptoms: Wilting of young palms, roots eaten, yellowing.
Management: Chlorpyriphos 20 EC @ 20 ml/palm soil drench in May. Metarhizium anisopliae @ 10g/palm.

5. MITE (Raoiella indica — Red Palm Mite):
Symptoms: Yellow/brown streaking on fronds, reduced photosynthesis.
Management: Fenazaquin 10 EC @ 1 ml/L or Dicofol 18.5 EC @ 2.5 ml/L spray.

6. SCALE INSECTS on nuts:
Management: Profenophos 50 EC @ 1 ml/L or Dimethoate 30 EC @ 1.5 ml/L spray.
